data.name: Aqeel
data.gender_notes: Aqeel is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aqeel is a respected Arabic name meaning 'wise' or 'intelligent'. It is often associated with deep thinking, good judgment, and scholarly nature. Traditionally, it has Islamic historical significance and is admired for its dignified tone. The name Aqeel carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Aqeel usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aqeel represents clarity of thought and connection to divine wisdom, symbolizing one who is thoughtful and insightful.
data.etymology: Aqeel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aqeel total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: عقيل
in_arabic.long_meaning: عقيل هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الذكي العاقل الحكماء، وهو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم. وقد ورد اسم عقيل في الحديث النبوي الشريف، ويعتبر من الأسماء المحببة عند المسلمين لما لها من معنى جميل وصفات حميدة.

in_urdu.name: عقیل
in_urdu.meaning: عقیل مطلب ہے عقلمند دانشور الحكماء
in_urdu.long_meaning: عقیل ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے عقلمند دانشور الحكماء۔ یہ نام قرآن کریم میں ذکر ہوا ہے اور اسلامی تقویم میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم معاشرے میں بھی یہ نام روایتی اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अक़ील
in_hindi.meaning: अक़ील का अर्थ है बुद्धिमान ज्ञानी व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: अक़ील एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है बुद्धिमान ज्ञानी व्यक्ति। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी इसका उपयोग होता है। इस नाम का चयन करने से बच्चे में ज्ञान और बुद्धिमत्ता की कामना की जाती है।

in_pashto.name: عقیل
in_pashto.meaning: عقیل دے مطلب دي عقلمند پوهاندو سړی
in_pashto.long_meaning: عقیل یو عربي نوم دی چی دے مطلب دي عقلمند پوهاندو سړی. دا نوم د افغانستان او پاکستان د پښتون قومونو کې دود دی او د اسلامي تذکرې په توګه کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Aqeel
in_english.meaning: Aqeel means intelligent, wise, and knowledgeable
in_english.long_meaning: Aqeel is an Arabic name that originates from the root 'aqala', which means to understand or to comprehend. The name signifies intelligence, wisdom, and knowledge. In Islamic tradition, Aqeel is considered a name of good omen, reflecting desirable qualities such as insight and understanding. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the aspiration for wisdom and intellect.

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل عقیل (a-q-eel)
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل عقیل (a-q-eel)

data.cultural_impact: The Arabic name Aqeel is highly regarded in Islamic culture as it signifies wisdom, intelligence, and depth of character. These qualities are esteemed highly in Islamic society and are a source of pride and respect. Additionally, the name Aqeel is used frequently in Islamic literature and historical accounts, and it is often bestowed upon characters known for their brilliance, insight, and shrewdness.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Aqeel represents a deep connection to knowledge, intelligence, and understanding. In Islam, knowledge is considered a gift from Allah, and acquiring and sharing knowledge is a noble pursuit. The name Aqeel is also associated with the idea of living a thoughtful, mindful, and intentional life. One who bears the name Aqeel is expected to use their intelligence and wisdom to make sound decisions, exhibit good judgment, and contribute positively to their community. Ultimately, the spiritual significance of the name Aqeel lies in encouraging the pursuit of knowledge, the cultivation of wisdom, and the use of these gifts to serve Allah and others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Aqeel signifies one who is mindful and attentive, always alert and responsive to the divine guidance and commands. It is a reminder to stay focused on the spiritual journey and to be ever ready to fulfill the obligations ordained by Allah.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Aqeel ibn Abi Talib was a cousin and companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Aqeel carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Aqeel was a prominent figure in early Islamic history and is mentioned in various hadiths and historical texts.
